# Feature: MIG-020 HTTP command/query transport layer

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-10-23; claimed after MIG-015 merge -->

## Intent

Typed HTTP queries and commands on the host (GATE-03 Variant B / Hono) with clear 401/403/409/validation mapping — validation + Policy Service before application mutations; no client role elevation.

## Preconditions

- GATE-03 APPROVED Hono+Colyseus; MIG-010/013/014 closed; Epic #773
- Cookie session actor resolution from MIG-014 available
- No production cutover

## Happy Path

- [x] Valid Actor + command DTO → validate → authorize → application command in documented order; response is role-scoped only
- [x] Idempotent retry after lost HTTP response returns same application result without double mutation

## Edge Cases

- [x] Missing auth → 401; missing right → 403; stale revision → 409; invalid payload → validation error; no partial state
- [x] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict)

## Regression

- [x] MIG-014/015 self-tests still PASS
- [x] Solo identity boundary unchanged

## Assumptions

- Minimal command/query surface sufficient for transport proof; full product Colyseus rooms remain MIG-021+
- Target paths: `server/src/api`, `server/src/application`

## Security Coverage

| ID | How |
| --- | --- |
| B-01 | Actor from cookie session only |
| B-04 | authorize before mutation |
| B-07 | Deny codes; no secrets in DTO |
| SC-01/02/03/06 | Auth session, fail-closed, origin, membership |

- Hono 4.13.13 + `@hono/node-server` 2.1.5 mounted from `server/src/http/route-registry.ts` (Better Auth `/api/auth` remains Node adapter)
